div.head: II As 20.3
div.ab: Ond beode mon on þam gemote, ðæt mon eal friþige, þæt se cyng friþian wille; ⁊ forgá þyfðe be his feore ⁊ be eallum þam þe he age.
⁊ beode man on þæm gemot, þæt mon friþige eall þæt se cyng friþian wille; ⁊ forga ðyfþa be his feore ⁊ be eallum ðæm ðe he age.
⁊ beode mon on þam gemote, þæt mon friþige eall þæt se cining friþian wille; ⁊ forgá þifþa be his feore ⁊ be eallum þam ðe he age.
Et edicatur in placito, ut pacificetur quicquid rex pacificari uelit; et omnis homo cesset a furto pro uita sua.
Ond beode mon on þam gemote, ðæt mon eal friþige, þæt se cyng friþian wille; ⁊ forgá þyfðe be his feore ⁊ be eallum þam þe he age.

Und in der Gerichtsversammlung werde geboten, dass [jeder]mann alles in Frieden schütze, was der König in Frieden schützen will, und sich Diebstahls enthalte bei [Strafe an] seinem Leben und allen dem, was er besitzt.

And let it be proclaimed at the court-meeting that [every]one is to protect in peace everything that the king wishes to protect in peace, and to refrain from theft on [pain of] his life and all that he owns.
And it shall be proclaimed in the assembly, that men shall respect everything which the king wishes to be respected, and refrain from theft on pain of death and [the loss of] all they possess.

And it is to be announced in the meeting that everyone is to be at peace with everything with which the king will be at peace, and to refrain from theft on pain of losing his life and all that he owns.

note.seg: De eo qui a furto cessare noluerit pro wita sua [De non cessantibus a. f. p. w. ohne sua Br] Rubrik MHkBr
De eo qui a furto cessare noluerit pro wita sua [De non cessantibus a. f. p. w. without sua Br] rubric MHkBr
Auf besonders diesen Satz bezieht Schmid die Antwort Kents III 2. Doch könnte letzteres das ganze Gesetz II As meinen. Dies, und nicht ersteres, scheint mir zuzutreffen auch für VI 10
Schmid refers Kent’s answer III 2 particularly to this sentence. But the latter could mean the whole law II As. This, and not the former, seems to me to apply to VI 10 as well

Offenbar lauten diese Zeilen formelhaft. Möglich, dass das Gebot durch den Königsvogt als Gerichtsvorstand sich verband mit dem Ehrlichkeitsversprechen (s. d. Gl 3 a. b) der Gerichtsgemeinde auf die Gesetze. Der Frieden (s. d. Gl 4—e) ist der des Königs, nicht mehr der des Volkes

These lines are evidently formulaic. It is possible that the command, through the king’s reeve as president of the court, was combined with the promise of honesty (see that word in Gl 3 a. b) of the court community to observe the laws. The peace (see that word in Gl 4—e) is the king’s, no longer the people’s
Nur den handhaften grossen Diebstahl (s. d. Gl 12. 17) des Mündigen bedroht Tod o. 1, dagegen jeden As später. Vgl. Gl Todesstrafe 3 h; Vermögenseinziehung 10 l

Above 1 threatens death only for major theft (see that word in Gl 12. 17) by a person of age taken in the act, whereas As later threatens it for every theft. Cf. Gl Todesstrafe 3 h; Vermögenseinziehung 10 l
